title: Vaporesso Dojo Blast Fresh Prefilled Pod & Refill – Blue Razz GB
description: Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast setup with the Blue Razz GB Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. Thanks to the integrated INSTA-JUICED technology, your 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid is housed independently from the coil in a high-capacity 10ml container, guaranteeing an absolutely fresh and flavourful experience upon activation. Blue Razz GB combines sweet and tangy Blue Raspberry notes with a chewy, confectionery-inspired profile for a punchy and playful vape. The bright, slightly tart berry notes are rounded out by a deeply satisfying sugary finish. Each pod and refill pack is fully compatible with all Dojo Blast kits, offering up to 10,000 puffs* per pack. Powered by an advanced COREX BLAST dual-mesh coil, it guarantees consistently dense vapour and exceptional flavour reproduction. How to Set Up Your Dojo Blast Fresh Pod: Remove the 2ml pod and the 10ml refill container from the packaging. Remove the red silicone plug from the top of the 2ml empty pod. Slide the 10ml refill container securely into the 2ml pod to assemble the pack. Wait for exactly five minutes to allow the e-liquid to fully saturate the coil. Insert the assembled pack into your Dojo Blast device and inhale to vape. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
